summary.value: Park Central Hotel New York, a hotel located southwest of Carnegie Hall at 870 7th Avenue, is a large, good-value Midtown pick that guests choose for its walk-everywhere location and attentive housekeeping. Rooms are basic and street-facing ones can be noisy, but most guests say it beat expectations for the price.

description.value: Park Central Hotel New York is a large hotel located southwest of Carnegie Hall at 870 7th Avenue, between West 55th and 56th streets, a few blocks from Central Park and the Theater District. Trip.com guests rate it 8.0 / 10 Very good 185 reviews and say The hotel's biggest advantage is its incredibly convenient location. Reviews praise value and diligent room service. Honest watch-outs: The room amenities are basic, and My room faced the street, which was a bit noisy, so request an inner room.

itineraryNote: Park Central Hotel New York: a big, walkable Midtown base southwest of Carnegie Hall at 870 7th Avenue; Central Park in the morning, Broadway at night.
review1: Park Central's Midtown position is the most praised feature, with guests calling the location extremely convenient. This is worth keeping in mind when planning the visit.
review2: Value comes up often, with guests saying the hotel exceeded their expectations for the price compared with other older New York properties.
review3: Service from housekeeping and in-room staff is described as diligent and excellent, adding to the sense that the hotel is well run.
review4: The honest caveat is that room amenities are fairly basic, so guests expecting luxury touches may find the rooms simple.
